verdict.rationale: Cloudflare docs describe point-in-time directory snapshots restorable from R2 and S3-compatible mounts for persistence across lifecycles, which covers filesystem state persistence, but there is no documented mechanism for pausing a running sandbox and resuming it with in-memory/process state intact (e.g., VM hibernate/checkpoint). Community discussion also flags that how file persistence actually works when a container goes idle is unclear, undercutting confidence in the claim. Missing for 10: explicit pause/resume API, evidence of memory/process state preservation (not just filesystem), and independent confirmation of persistence behavior.
